The Master of Business Administration (MBA) at the University of Akron College of Business is one of the highest ranked and most affordable MBA programs in Northeast Ohio. The program is structured to accommodate working professionals, with classes offered in two eight-week sessions per semester, allowing students to focus on one class at a time while taking up to two courses per semester. Most full-time working students complete the program in two years, though it can be completed in as little as one year for full-time students.

The MBA program emphasizes interdisciplinary skills and a strategic approach to prepare graduates to lead organizations effectively in a global business environment. The program is offered in both fully online and evening formats, taught by the same College of Business faculty regardless of delivery method.

The University of Akron College of Business provides a transformative learning experience through innovative academic programs, global thought leadership, professional development opportunities, and strong business connections. The college offers flexible evening and online programs, convenient locations, a diverse student body, and expert faculty. Its programs are nationally ranked and accredited, equipping graduates to address the challenges of the global economy.
